paper.title_en: Renormalization group improved black holes in non-commutative momentum-dependent spacetime geometry
paper.abstract_en: We investigate black holes (BHs) in momentum-dependent spacetime geometry and assess its quantum Reissner-Nordström (RN) consistency with the weak gravity conjecture (WGC). Quantum corrections are introduced through the non-commutative momentum space algebra as the quantization process, and spacetime renormalization approach as a map between momentum and spacetime spaces. For the Schwarzschild case, thermodynamic analysis indicates the existence of a hot (non-zero temperature) BH remnant when evaporation stops (the entropy becomes zero), obeying a complementary third law for black hole thermodynamics. We extend this framework to the RN solution and examine its extremal limit. For large BHs with $M \gg M_P$ ($M_P$ for Planck mass), the quantum-improved RN geometry exhibits a non-zero Hawking temperature in the extremal case, consistent with the WGC, which stipulates that extremal states should not be exactly stable or cold. The resulting momentum-dependent metric and thermodynamic properties are shown to reproduce the results derived from the Poincaré algebra (classical model) in the infrared (IR) regime.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 论文研究动量依赖时空几何中的黑洞热力学，并探讨其与弱引力猜想的相容性，具有理论深度和新颖性。
decision.title_zh: 非对易动量依赖时空几何中的重整化群改进黑洞
decision.abstract_zh: 我们研究了动量依赖时空几何中的黑洞（BHs），并评估其量子Reissner-Nordström（RN）解与弱引力猜想（WGC）的一致性。量子修正通过非对易动量空间代数作为量子化过程引入，时空重整化方法作为动量空间与时空之间的映射。对于Schwarzschild情形，热力学分析表明当蒸发停止（熵变为零）时存在一个热的（非零温度）黑洞残余，服从黑洞热力学的互补第三定律。我们将此框架推广到RN解并检验其极端极限。对于大黑洞（M >> M_P，M_P为普朗克质量），量子改进的RN几何在极端情形下表现出非零Hawking温度，与WGC一致，WGC规定极端态不应完全稳定或冷。所得动量依赖度规和热力学性质被证明在红外（IR）范围内重现了由Poincaré代数（经典模型）推导的结果。
